records.rationale: RSA is broken by Shor. ML-KEM replaces RSA's key-transport role; AES-256-GCM encrypts the message.
records.trade_offs: The KEM ciphertext adds 1,088 B to the payload, which is easier to detect when hidden. ML-KEM-512 is lighter; ML-KEM-1024 suits the longest-lived data.
records.where_to_use: Use it wherever the code calls RSA to protect the message. The sender encapsulates to the receiver's ML-KEM public key, derives an AES key with HKDF, and encrypts with AES-256-GCM.

records.today: SHA-256 of a passphrase, frames 0 to 255 only
records.technique: 256-bit random key with HKDF or HMAC-SHA256 to pick frames
records.quantum_status: symmetric; Grover halves 256 bits to about 128
records.rationale: Symmetric primitives need no PQC algorithm. Fix the key strength and cover the whole video.
records.where_to_use: Use it where the video code chooses which frames carry data. Derive frame positions from a random 256-bit key so every frame is reachable.

records.rationale: CRC32 is not cryptographic and acts as a key-check oracle. The GCM tag makes tampering fail loudly.
records.trade_offs: Never reuse a nonce with the same key.
records.where_to_use: Use it in place of the CRC32 check. Decryption fails if any byte of the payload was changed.

records.rationale: Proves who sent the payload and detects tampering before decryption.
records.trade_offs: Adds 3,309 B. SLH-DSA (FIPS 205) is the conservative alternative with much larger signatures.
records.where_to_use: Use it when the receiver must know who sent the hidden message. Sign the payload before embedding and verify after extraction.

records.technique: key-dependent pixel order (not a PQC question)
records.quantum_status: not part of the quantum percentage
records.rationale: Steganalysis, not Shor or Grover, decides this layer.
records.trade_offs: A larger PQC payload is easier to detect, so measure it.
records.where_to_use: Use a key-dependent pixel or frame order where the embedding code picks its start position, then measure detectability with the steganalysis scripts.
